text:
Lina (Partner Eng): FYI partner flagged a regression after driver 537.xx rollout on their dedicated nodes. latency up, occasional kernel aborts.

Owen (Infra): can you paste their quick logs?

Lina (Partner Eng): snippet from partner: 
[2026-03-20T09:04:12Z] launch_kernel: cuBLAS status error 13
[2026-03-20T09:04:12Z] runtime: kernel retry then abort
[2026-03-20T09:04:13Z] perf: token p95 +25% over baseline

Priya (Product): are marketplace images using driver 537 by default now?

Owen (Infra): yes, last week we updated base images to driver 537/CUDA12.2 for newer hardware. we should pause and pin if partners are impacted.

Lina (Partner Eng): partner wants a backported image while we investigate. they need it hosted internally for their CI.

NVIDIA-Escalation-Bot: recommended next step: collect minimal repro, nvprof/metrics, and open vendor escalation referencing kernel id 0x1a3f.

Owen (Infra): plan: 1) immediate mitigation: pin marketplace runtime to driver 535/CUDA12.1; 2) produce backport image for partner (redwood/internal-backports:driver535-cuda12.1-20260320); 3) run fleet regression across driver 535 vs 537 with representative workloads.

Priya (Product): hold any joint announcements with affected partners. legal/comms notified.

Lina (Partner Eng): I'll send vendor repro + perf traces now and request ETA. will CC partner for transparency but keep public messaging off.

Owen (Infra): creating infra ticket INF-11721 (pin images, backport image, fleet matrix). assigning to @Owen and tagging @QA.

Docs-Bot: suggested doc update: add marketplace advisory notice: "For latency-sensitive workloads, we recommend pinning to driver 535/CUDA 12.1 until further notice." Draft link: /docs/releases/marketplace-advisory-20260320.md

Priya (Product): small ask: Lina, include partner contact details and whether they want a hosted image URL or a handed-off tarball.

Lina (Partner Eng): partner prefers hosted URL. @Owen can you stand up a short-lived private registry entry?

Owen (Infra): yes, will publish and share link in INF-11721 once ready.

NVIDIA-Escalation-Bot: escalation opened with vendor case #NV-5268. vendor requested repro + nvprof and driver logs.

Lina (Partner Eng): action items recap: - @Owen: pin marketplace images + publish backport image (INF-11721) - @Lina: send repro to vendor + partner comms - @Priya: hold partner public launch + coordinate with comms - @QA: run regression matrix across drivers

Priya (Product): thanks all. keep this thread for updates; escalate to leadership only if vendor provides a timeline >72 hours.

Lina (Partner Eng): will update when vendor responds. keeping it narrow for now. :thumbsup:
